Elements hidden via inline style="font-size:0" render nothing and must not appear in the output

```python title="Python"
from html_to_markdown import convert

def main() -> None:
    html = '<p>visible</p><div style="font-size:0px; color:rgb(255,255,255)"><span style="line-height:0">secret zero size text</span></div><p>also visible</p>'
    result = convert(html)
    print(result.content)

main()
```
